name.en: Flat concrete slab, anchored base plates and bolted tilted frame
name.es: Losa de hormigón plana, placas base ancladas y estructura inclinada atornillada

description.en: Tilted PV frame bolted to base plates that are fixed to a concrete flat roof slab with chemical (HIT-HY 200, HIT-RE 500) or mechanical (HSL-3, HSA) anchors. Anchor data from Hilti documentation; base plate, frame and slab data not found.
description.es: Estructura fotovoltaica inclinada atornillada a placas base fijadas a una losa de hormigón de cubierta plana con anclajes químicos (HIT-HY 200, HIT-RE 500) o mecánicos (HSL-3, HSA). Datos de anclaje de la documentación Hilti; datos de placa base, estructura y losa no encontrados.

typical_use: Flat concrete roofs where ballast or membrane penetration is not allowed and the slab can take anchor loads. Slab capacity and anchor design are the designer's responsibility.
